title: Volcano Balloon (Bag) Tube Set – single
description:
Get ready for an explosive vapor experience with the Volcano Balloon Set!

Made with premium Balloon Tube material, this set includes 3 meters of balloon material. It is perfect for use with volcano vaporizers.

The Balloon Tube material is food-safe, heat-proof and odour-free, providing a clean and safe vaping experience. The set also includes a high-quality bag easily attached to the vaporizer, ensuring maximum efficiency and convenience.

Whether you’re a seasoned vaper or new to the game, the Volcano Balloon Tube Set is the perfect addition to your vaping collection. Get yours today and experience the ultimate vaping experience like never before!

Looking for more bags and want to save $?
16 Pack of Balloons available CLICK HERE

IMPORTANT NOTE: All boxes of bags originally come in the official Storz box. If you are in a rural or remote shipping area, especially if Urban shipping is selected vs the Province shipping, we will remove the bags from the box and ship via stamp mail. We will also sometimes do this for orders that only include one box of bags depending on the shipping cost. This is to save both us and our clients shipping $, Storz instructions are still included. The difference in shipping will be refunded to your payment method.

For use with the Volcano Solid Valve or the Easy Valve with Adapter
